description: While stage is needs_confirmation it returns the business profile and the proposed buyer questions. While running it returns progress. When finished it returns visibility numbers, the brands AI named, and a count of lost questions. Needs login with scope reports:read.

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level fields to return, for example fields=id,stage. Omit to get everything. Spend fewer tokens by asking for less.

reportId.description: Report id from POST /api/v1/reports or GET /api/v1/reports.

name: get_report
title: Read one report: stage, setup to confirm, or results
